The British, French and Belgian conquest of German Kamerun during the First World War, from August 1914 to early 1916.

Douala fell in September 1914, but German and African troops fought on inland, and many Germans escaped to the Spanish colony of Rio Muni in 1916. The mountain fort at Mora held out until February 1916. After the war the League of Nations split the land: France took most of it, Britain two strips along Nigeria. The two parts had different languages, laws and schools for forty years, the root of the Anglophone question. See also French Cameroons.
sum: The British, French and Belgian conquest of German Kamerun during the First World War, from August 1914 to early 1916.
